abilities.name: Disintegrate
abilities.description: Argus' abilities apply a stack of Disintegration for 2s, causing subsequent instances of ability damage to deal 4 (+3%) bonus magical damage. Each stack of Disintegration deals 50% more damage, stacking infinitely (capped at 12 against Monsters).

abilities.name: Arcrune Conduit
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing 55 (+55%) physical damage.

abilities.name: Dread Nova
abilities.description: Argus lobs an unstable orb of energy. Upon landing it explodes, dealing 80/120/160/200/240 (+50%) magical damage to all nearby Targets and Stuns them for 1/1.05/1.1/1.15/1.2s.

abilities.name: Ether Crystal
abilities.description: Argus summons an Ether Crystal at the target location for 2s. The Crystal will Push Enemy Heroes from the center and Lift Allied Heroes into the air before producing a storm that deals 15/25/35/45/55 (+18%) magical damage every 0.5s to nearby Enemies and Slows by 25/30/35/40/45% for 0.5s. After the duration the Crystal will implode, Pulling all Enemies within to the center.

abilities.name: Particle Shredder
abilities.description: Argus fires homing projectiles from his Abyssal Staff for up to 3.5s. Each projectile consumes mana and deals 13/20/27/34/41 (+18%) per blast. At maximum rank, Particle Shredder can be used indefinitely.

abilities.name: Synaptic Obliterator
abilities.description: After a short delay, Argus channels for up to 8s, gaining immunity to pushes and pulls whilst deploying his ultimate weapon to fire up to 3/4/5 powerful Energy Beams. Each beam deals 100/130/160 (+25%) magical damage (increased by up to 150% based on the Target's missing health) and Slows Enemies hit by 60% for 0.5s.

augments.name: Arcane Engine
augments.description: Dealing Ability Damage to Heroes grants you 1.75% Movement Speed for 1.5s, stacking infinitely - 0.15s CD.

augments.name: Mana Catalyst
augments.description: Restore Mana equal to 10% of damage dealt to Heroes, reduced to 1.5% for Non-Heroes. Basic Attacks restore 2x more.

augments.name: Infinite Obliteration
augments.description: Synaptic Obliterator's projectile now have infinite range, travel 25% faster, and Slow for 50% longer.

abilities.name: Reaper of Souls
abilities.description: Sevarog gains Souls when he Kills an Enemy with an ability. Each Soul grants 2 bonus health. Sevarog reaches an additional Tier of power at 40.0/80.0/120.0/160.0 Souls, gaining 40.0/80.0/180.0/350.0 bonus health and new effects: Tier 1: +5% Omnivamp. Tier 2: Gain an Aura that Shreds nearby Enemy Heroes' Magical Armor by 15%. Tier 3: Siphon grants 2x Maximum Health from Stealing. Tier 4: Reflect 10% of damage taken to nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Siphon
abilities.description: Strike forward with a spectral hand, dealing 80.0/95.0/110.0/125.0/140.0 (+4% max health)(+40% magical power) magical damage to all Enemies. Deals 30.0/35.0/40.0/45.0/50.0 additional damage to Monsters. If Siphon damages an Enemy Hero, Sevarog steals 1.8/2.0/2.2/2.4/2.6% of their Maximum Health for 15s.

abilities.name: Subjugate
abilities.description: Call down a miasma of dark energy, dealing 60.0/75.0/90.0/105.0/120.0 (+40% magical power) magical damage to all Enemies in the area, Slowing them by 30% and Chaining them to the center for 2s. If a Chained target leaves the zone, they take 75.0/90.0/105.0/120.0/135.0 (+60% magical power) magical damage and are Stunned for 1.25s.

abilities.name: Phantom Rush
abilities.description: Sevarog dashes forward through the air, dealing 40.0/60.0/80.0/100.0/120.0 (+2.5% max health) magical damage to all Enemies he passes through and Fearing them for 1s.

abilities.name: Colossal Blow
abilities.description: Deliver a heavy blow from Sevarog's hammer, dealing 200.0/330.0/460.0 (+75% magical power) magical damage to all Enemies in front of him. Enemy Heroes struck by the blow are Knocked Back, sending them flying. At maximum rank, Colossal Blow Executes Minions.

augments.name: Unholy Pursuit
augments.description: Phantom Rush grants 2 Souls when it damages a Hero. Its Cooldown also resets when Colossal Blow hits a Hero.

augments.name: Grim Harvest
augments.description: Siphon now Executes Enemies that fall below 6% Max Health.

augments.name: Gravebreaker
augments.description: Colossal Blow damages Towers for 25% of their Max Health. Its Knock Back is also 15% stronger, with each Soul Tier increasing this by 35% more.
